title: Evacuation Grab List (5 and 15 Minutes)
description: Use this list when you are told to leave: grab the 5-minute items first, and add the 15-minute items only if you truly have time.

sources.title: All-Hazard Evacuation Steps (Ready, Set, Go and the 5 P's)

items.text: 5 min: People - get everyone out and accounted for; at a 'Go Now' order, leave immediately with nothing else
5 min: Pets in carriers or on leashes
5 min: Pre-packed go-bags
5 min: Prescriptions and critical medical devices (oxygen, CPAP, insulin, epinephrine) with chargers
5 min: Phone, charger, wallet, keys, and cash
5 min: Glasses, hearing aids, and mobility aids
5 min: Document folder or encrypted drive with ID, insurance, and medical records
5 min: Sturdy shoes and a jacket on everyone
15 min: Extra water and food from the pantry
15 min: Baby supplies (formula, diapers, wipes) and pet food and records
15 min: Laptop, power banks, and cables
15 min: Change of clothes and toiletries for a few days
15 min: Priceless items - photos, heirlooms, and keepsakes that fit in one small bag
15 min: Sleeping bags or blankets and pillows for a shelter
15 min, if safe and officials advise: close windows and doors, and shut off utilities as directed
15 min: Leave a note saying when you left and where you are going
Take the route officials give, never drive through floodwater or smoke you cannot see through, and never go back for items
Text your out-of-area contact once you are safe
Before any emergency: post a copy of this list by the door with where each item is kept
Before any emergency: assign each family member items to grab and practice leaving in 10 minutes
